pages.title: Cop Simulator: My Prison 3D
pages.creator: Prime Web Publish
pages.description: Run a detention facility in Cop Simulator: My Prison 3D. Build additional cell blocks, hire employees, and keep order while developing the prison's income. Your decisions affect both the security of the facility and the budget available for its expansion.

pages.title: Node Conquest
pages.creator: AnuVibe Games
pages.description: Capture linked territories in Node Conquest. Send forces between strategic nodes, protect the positions you hold, and manage resources for further attacks. Upgrades and special abilities help you respond as stronger enemies contest control of the battlefield.

pages.title: Cute Mahjong Connect
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Pair animal tiles in Cute Mahjong Connect. Select identical pictures with a clear connecting route and remove every pair before the timer expires. Hints, shuffles, and time-freezing boosters offer assistance when a crowded layout makes the next match difficult to find.

pages.title: Escape the Alien Prison
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Break out of a spacecraft in Escape the Alien Prison. Cross hazardous parkour courses, hack security panels, and fight alien threats while searching for freedom. Double jumps and sprinting help with difficult routes, while interactive doors and puzzles block the way forward.

pages.title: Solitaire Quest
pages.creator: BUSIDOL
pages.description: Sort a deck in Solitaire Quest, a version of classic Klondike. Reorganize the columns to uncover cards and build the suit foundations upward. Plan moves around the cards you expose as you work toward clearing the complete deal.

pages.title: Fish Out of Water!
pages.creator: Yes2Games
pages.description: Send a group of aquatic characters skimming across the ocean in Fish Out of Water!. Swipe to throw each fish and try to maximize its distance and bounces. Different flight behavior gives each character its own approach to improving your overall result.

pages.title: Rich Choice Run
pages.creator: Raccoon
pages.description: Make lifestyle choices along a running course in Rich Choice Run. Slide between lanes to select potential boyfriends and gather expensive items that raise your status. Poor choices reduce the value of the final outcome, so watch what each route offers.

pages.title: Mahjong Solitaire Zodiac
pages.creator: Anna Inc
pages.description: Clear layered boards in Mahjong Solitaire Zodiac. Match identical tiles only when neither is covered and each has a free side. Removing a pair opens additional possibilities, so consider which pieces your choice will expose before continuing the layout.

pages.title: Road Digging Puzzle
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Excavate a route through the ground in Road Digging Puzzle. Remove earth to open a passage and account for how the level reacts under physics. Water, lava, breakable glass, and explosive hazards add complications to where you choose to dig.

pages.title: Avatar Life My Town
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Create family stories in Avatar Life My Town. Move through a dollhouse-style home, interact with its characters, and take care of their everyday needs. Prepare meals and role-play household activities as you build your own version of life in the town.

pages.title: Aventador Vice Crime City
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Explore busy streets with a sports car and canine companion in Aventador Vice Crime City. Watch traffic and fuel levels while choosing among four driving modes. Customize the car's appearance and performance, and avoid hitting pedestrians unless you are prepared for police pursuit.

pages.title: Freecell Solitaire
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Build four suit foundations from ace to king in Freecell Solitaire. Reorganize eight columns using descending, alternating-color sequences and use four free cells as temporary storage. Clearing space helps expose the cards needed to bring the full deck into order.

pages.title: Color Block Jam
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Reorganize colored pieces in Color Block Jam. Drag blocks into new positions and look for the matching arrangements needed to clear the board. Plan how each move changes the space available before tackling the next part of the layout.

pages.title: Pull The Pins
pages.creator: HyHyGames
pages.description: Reunite two brothers in Pull The Pins. Remove barriers in the order that lets the younger boy reach his sibling safely. Each pulled pin changes the situation, so inspect what it will release before committing to the next part of the rescue.

pages.title: Mahjong Zen Garden
pages.creator: Gametok
pages.description: Remove identical tile pairs in Mahjong Zen Garden. Select pieces that are uncovered and free on at least one side, using boosters when the layout is difficult. Choose timed Classic play or untimed Meditation, and progress through the campaign toward unlocking Endless mode.

pages.title: Hotel Manager
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Buy properties and bankrupt rival owners in Hotel Manager. Build hotels, upgrade them when you revisit, and collect fees from opponents who land there. Seasonal spaces alter hotel charges, while event cards can help or hinder your finances as you move around the board.

pages.title: Skibidi Toilet Clicker
pages.creator: PixelBro
pages.description: Damage monsters with repeated clicks in Skibidi Toilet Clicker. Earn money for stronger weapons and improve your damage and income with multipliers. Open weapon cases for additional rewards and build enough attack power to handle the tougher enemies and bosses ahead.

pages.title: Good and Evil DressUp
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Create contrasting magical-school looks in Good and Evil DressUp. Choose clothing and fabrics such as black leather or satin to design an enchantress's outfit. Experiment with combinations that give the characters distinct appearances as they compete to become the school's most fashionable students.

pages.title: Skibidi Toilet Basketball
pages.creator: Merson
pages.description: Send a character's head into a toilet-shaped target in Skibidi Toilet Basketball. Aim throws around the obstacles and work on landing successful shots. The unusual basketball challenge focuses on improving your accuracy as the layouts become harder to negotiate.

pages.title: Pyramid Solitaire
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Remove a pyramid of cards in Pyramid Solitaire by pairing exposed values that total thirteen. Kings clear individually, while the draw pile supplies additional face-up cards when needed. Find combinations that uncover the remaining layers and work toward an empty pyramid.

pages.title: Hopper bunny
pages.creator: Ramblo Digital Media
pages.description: Climb between tree stumps in Hopper bunny. Gather carrots to increase the score and strengthen the rabbit's hops while avoiding troublesome items along the way. Special birds assist with longer jumps, helping you continue farther through the ongoing climb.

pages.title: Noob vs Pro vs Stickman Jailbreak
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Escape imprisonment in Noob vs Pro vs Stickman Jailbreak. Guide the block-world characters through a sequence of prison-break challenges and fight enemy stick figures along the route. Each level presents another obstacle between the prisoners and their chance to get out.

pages.title: Forest Match 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Collect fruit through matching puzzles in Forest Match 2. Form matching groups while following a saga map through a magical woodland setting. Additional stages bring more collection tasks and opportunities to uncover coin chests as the forest adventure continues.

pages.title: Cannon Minimal
pages.creator: Gamealliz
pages.description: Land a cannonball in a basket in Cannon Minimal. Adjust each shot to account for the target's position and the path the ball will follow. Twenty levels turn the same shooting objective into different challenges of aim and trajectory.

pages.title: Desert Car Racing
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Race over winding sandy routes in Desert Car Racing. Handle steep inclines and looping roads while keeping control of the vehicle at speed. Unlock four available cars and compare their handling as you work through the desert courses.

pages.title: Awesome Conquest
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Reclaim occupied territory in Awesome Conquest. Develop your city, expand mining to increase cash, and build a temple that grants powerful interventions. Strengthen the military alongside the economy, then send the army into battle against the red forces holding your land.

pages.title: Scorpion Solitaire
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Build four descending suit sequences in Scorpion Solitaire. Move stacks onto cards of the same suit and the next higher rank, working from king through ace. Choose a difficulty, use the final three stock cards when needed, and remember that undoing moves reduces your score.

pages.title: Gems Tetriz Match 3
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Arrange falling jewels into matching lines in Gems Tetriz Match 3. Move the pieces left, right, or downward to align gems horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. Reach the required score to advance, choosing placements that keep useful combinations available as more pieces arrive.

pages.title: Frosty Ice Cream! Icy dessert
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Prepare frozen treats in Frosty Ice Cream! Icy dessert. Combine the ingredients and choose flavors such as chocolate, strawberry, or vanilla to make a personalized dessert. Explore different ice-cream varieties as you work through the preparation and finishing choices.

pages.title: Merge Cannon: Chicken Defense
pages.creator: TinyDobbins
pages.description: Hold off an approaching poultry army in Merge Cannon: Chicken Defense. Combine cannons to improve their strength and upgrade the castle they protect. Keep developing the defense through waves of chickens until you are ready to face the larger boss.

pages.title: Kitty Doctor
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Care for ill and injured cats in Kitty Doctor. Examine patients at the animal clinic and use the appropriate tools for problems such as fever or embedded thorns. Work through the treatment steps to help each kitten recover before attending to another patient.

pages.title: Red and Green Candy Forest
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Cross a candy-filled course with two colored characters in Red and Green Candy Forest. Collect sweets for points and negotiate the obstacles spread across twenty levels. Play alone or with a partner while guiding the pair toward the end of the adventure.

pages.title: Xmas 2020 Sudoku
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Fill a seasonal logic grid in Xmas 2020 Sudoku. Place Christmas items so each row, column, and three-by-three region contains every item exactly once. Compare the existing symbols to identify which picture belongs in each remaining empty cell.

pages.title: Eliminate the Zombies
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Use ricocheting shots to reach hidden undead in Eliminate the Zombies. Bounce ammunition around metal beams and walls, or shoot chains to drop heavy objects onto enemies. Study the level's supports and barriers before deciding how to eliminate the sheltered targets.

pages.title: Princess Cake Shop Cool Summer
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Help a royal dessert chef prepare two frozen treats in Princess Cake Shop Cool Summer. Work alongside Elsa as she develops new ice-cream offerings for hot weather. Follow the cooking sequence and finish both desserts for Anna to sample.

pages.title: Pong Ball Masters
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Return a bouncing ball with a paddle in Pong Ball Masters. Keep it from passing your side and direct it beyond the opposing player to score. Choose a single-player match or share the contest through the multiplayer option.

pages.title: Mega Ramp Car Racing Stunts GT 2020
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Drive across oversized stunt courses in Mega Ramp Car Racing Stunts GT 2020. Use the arrow keys to handle the car through ramps and difficult tracks. The challenge centers on keeping control of the vehicle while completing the high-speed driving route.

pages.title: Six Little Kittens
pages.creator: Baby Daisy Games
pages.description: Rebuild cat photographs in Six Little Kittens. Choose one of six pictures and an easy, medium, or hard puzzle before dragging its pieces into position. Compare the kittens' features and the background to restore the complete image.

pages.title: Zombie Curse
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Drive through an undead-filled stunt course in Zombie Curse. Tilt the vehicle, jump over terrain, and use boosts while crushing or shooting zombies. Collect coins and aids such as magnets as you try to survive farther through the hills and hazards.

pages.title: Sprengen Match
pages.creator: Kostenlose Spiele
pages.description: Clear connected color groups in Sprengen Match. Click at least two matching blocks to remove them and work toward the level's objective. Power-ups and boosters provide extra ways to handle difficult arrangements as you progress through the puzzles.

pages.title: Brick Dodge
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Guide a block through gaps in approaching barriers in Brick Dodge. Move it into line with each opening before the brick wall reaches it. The gaps change position and arrive quickly, requiring you to keep adjusting without hitting the surrounding blocks.

pages.title: Go Traval Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Arrange travel-themed picture sections in Go Traval Slide. Select one of three images and a puzzle mode, then restore the scene from its scrambled parts. Compare the details across the pieces until each section fits the completed illustration.

pages.title: Christmas Math
pages.creator: Jam Game Studio
pages.description: Choose the missing arithmetic operation in Christmas Math. Compare the displayed values and select the operator that makes the calculation correct. The pace increases as the game continues, giving you less time to recognize each equation's solution.

pages.title: Golem Crusher
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Stop approaching stone creatures in Golem Crusher. Tap a golem to kill it and keep working through the attackers appearing in the play area. The task centers on spotting targets and selecting them quickly enough to remove the incoming threats.

pages.title: Monster Truck Tricky Stunt Race Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Race powerful off-road vehicles in Monster Truck Tricky Stunt Race Game. Compete against rivals across hills, valleys, and muddy tracks while handling jumps along the route. Keep the truck under control as you try to finish ahead of the other drivers.

pages.title: Fast Racing Cars Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Search car scenes for concealed objects in Fast Racing Cars Hidden. Inspect each picture and select the ten hidden shapes to complete its collection. Track the found total as you scan the vehicle details for the remaining targets.

pages.title: Fast Math 2
pages.creator: GGMagenta
pages.description: Answer arithmetic questions against an increasingly tight countdown in Fast Math 2. Each new question raises the difficulty and leaves less time to respond. Keep solving the calculations correctly to extend your streak and build a higher score.

pages.title: Flying Birds Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild airborne animal pictures in Flying Birds Slide. Choose among three images and three modes, then rearrange the scrambled sections. Use the birds' outlines and surrounding scenery to determine where each piece belongs in the finished scene.

pages.title: Word Search Transport
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Find vehicle names in a letter grid in Word Search Transport. Follow the list at the side and drag from each word's first letter to its last. Answers can run horizontally, vertically, or diagonally in either direction.

pages.title: Toy Car Parking Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Direct small vehicles into parking positions in Toy Car Parking Game. Click a car to begin its parking action and judge when to send the next one. The game uses simple mouse input to turn each vehicle's approach into a placement challenge.

pages.title: Crazy Driver
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Steer around road traffic in Crazy Driver. Use the mouse or on-screen controls to keep the vehicle away from the cars threatening its path. The arcade challenge is to preserve the drive without letting an avoidable collision end the attempt.

pages.title: Airplane Memory Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Remember the positions of aircraft pictures in Airplane Memory Challenge. Reveal cards, locate identical planes, and match the pairs to clear the arrangement. Work on finding all the partners efficiently by using what earlier reveals have shown you.

pages.title: Bentley Flying Spur Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble car photographs in Bentley Flying Spur Puzzle. Six images offer puzzles with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Pick a piece count and fit the sections together to reveal the complete view of the luxury sedan.

pages.title: Funny Animals Coloring Book
pages.creator: Hexa Games
pages.description: Paint five jungle creatures in Funny Animals Coloring Book. Choose a shade from the movable palette and click the area you want to color. Drag the color panel when needed and build your own version of each animal illustration.

pages.title: Bff Princess Perfect Bedroom Decor
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Decorate a shared room in Bff Princess Perfect Bedroom Decor. Select colors and furniture for the friends' interior, then help them choose outfits. The game combines arranging their living space with completing the characters' looks after the decoration is finished.

pages.title: Red Ball 6
pages.creator: Bin Studio
pages.description: Roll through a platform adventure in Red Ball 6. Move left and right, jump across hazards, and collect the required yellow stars. Use the stopping control when an obstacle calls for a more cautious approach before continuing the ball's journey.

pages.title: Jewel Legend
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Swap neighboring diamonds in Jewel Legend to make matching lines of at least three. Complete collection challenges while working through the mine-themed adventure. Combinations of four or more create explosive bonuses that help remove difficult sections of the board.

pages.title: Jewelry Match
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Complete gem-collection challenges in Jewelry Match. Form matching groups to remove pieces and gather the items requested by each level. Boosters provide assistance with tougher arrangements, while star rankings give you a result to improve after clearing a board.

pages.title: Slendrina Must Die: The House
pages.creator: danygames.com
pages.description: Search a haunted building in Slendrina Must Die: The House. Find the papers that reveal its secret while using weapons to defend against the woman stalking you. Explore quickly, collect useful items, and work toward uncovering the way to end the threat.

pages.title: Pixel Soldiers Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Assemble block-style military pictures in Pixel Soldiers Jigsaw. Start with the first image and solve it to unlock more scenes. Choose layouts with 25, 49, or 100 pieces and rebuild each soldier illustration from its scattered sections.

pages.title: Santa Claus Differences
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Find seven changes between seasonal pictures in Santa Claus Differences. Each level gives you one minute to compare the images and identify every alteration. Ten scenes provide new Christmas details to inspect as you progress through the search.

pages.title: Grim Fall
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Protect a small character by removing its supports in Grim Fall. Destroy colored blocks and account for how the remaining arrangement reacts under physics. Complete the rescue puzzle while working toward all three stars in each level.

pages.title: Triskaidekaphobia
pages.creator: Enclave Games
pages.description: Escape pursuing numbers through a dark forest in Triskaidekaphobia. Click or press the up arrow to jump between surfaces, keeping clear of spikes along the route. Collect restorative pickups and try to maintain the distance separating you from the Thirteens.

pages.title: Monsters and Cake
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Feed hungry creatures through color matching in Monsters and Cake. Connect at least three neighboring monsters of one color on the hexagonal grid to make them eat. Work through different cakes before the timer expires, using longer chains when available.

pages.title: Suzy Different Outfit Events
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare three looks for a busy day in Suzy Different Outfit Events. Choose a separate outfit for each occasion on Suzy's schedule. Compare the available fashion pieces and give her clothing combinations suited to the different events she plans to attend.

pages.title: Angry Gran Jump Up
pages.creator: AceViral.com LTD
pages.description: Keep a determined grandmother climbing in Angry Gran Jump Up. Jump higher, collect coins, and stay clear of traps throughout the ascent. Upgrade power-ups to support later attempts as you work toward reaching a greater height.

pages.title: Whimsical Wedding Dressup
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Create a bridal trial look in Whimsical Wedding Dressup. Help the model through makeover and makeup activities, then choose an outfit for the wedding-themed styling session. Coordinate the available pieces into a finished interpretation of a whimsical bridal appearance.

pages.title: The Last Ninja
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Throw shurikens at opposing fighters in The Last Ninja. Line up your attacks and eliminate the rival ninjas encountered during the challenge. Keep making successful hits to raise the score as the throwing contest continues.

pages.title: Zombie Days
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Run from an undead horde in Zombie Days. Choose a starting advantage, such as a weapon or extra distance, before beginning the escape. Keep moving through the danger and try to stay beyond the reach of the zombies pursuing you.

pages.title: Mystic Mahjong Adventures
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clear available tile pairs in Mystic Mahjong Adventures. Match identical icons on pieces that are uncovered and open at a side. Complete additional goals, such as collecting diamond-marked tiles or chaining the same icon, while using bonus tiles to support your progress.

pages.title: Fairy Princess Dresser 2
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Prepare a magical character's look in Fairy Princess Dresser 2. Apply makeup and choose clothing that suits a royal fairy theme. Experiment with colors and outfit combinations to give the princess a complete style for her next appearance.
